card.name: Last part of imaging agent brand names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a capitalized brand name for a dye, contrast or imaging product, such as ZYOGREEN, OMNISCAN, MembraneBlue or MYOVIEW. It also fires on the end of other trade names like Sep-Pak and Plasma-Lyte.

modes.label: Dye and contrast names
modes.description: Ending of a diagnostic or surgical dye or contrast brand name in use instructions.
modes.example: Do not perform radioactive iodine uptake studies for at least one week following the use of ZYOG<<REEN>>.

modes.label: Other product trade names
modes.description: Ending of a device or fluid brand name that is a compound word.
modes.example: push 10 mL of 200 proof ethanol through the Sep-P<<ak>> cartridge.
